translation:
In the conditions of injury with pain from blood deficiency, the signs are fever, thirst, vexation, oppression, and dizziness, worsening in the late afternoon (日晡); this is a condition of yin deficiency with internal heat. One should treat it with Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯) with added moutan bark (丹皮), ophiopogon (麥冬), schisandra (五味子), cinnamon bark (肉桂), and drynaria (骨碎補).
<ins>Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯)</ins> (the formula is found under diffusion and settling of stagnant blood, 瘀血泛注)
